title: Repair the dev index and stray plan files
description:
dev/index.md links a nonexistent AGENTS.md and omits five real directories (design/, eval/, experiments/, plans/, presentations/). Three plan files sit loose at dev/ root outside the documented doc lifecycle, one of them marked complete.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: dev/index.md links only existing files and describes every top-level dev/ directory
- [hard] REQ-02: Loose plan files at dev/ root are moved into their lifecycle locations, with issue doc links re-pointed at the final paths
- [hard] REQ-03: dev/ root holds only the index and authoring conventions
